description: Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited - The Amalgamated Company will Operate as Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited The Respective Amalgamation will be Effective from 1st July 2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the amalgamation of two commercial companies (Colombo Commercial Fertilizers Limited and Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited) under the Companies Act. The content specifically deals with corporate restructuring through merger, which falls under business and commercial matters rather than government structure/personnel changes. This aligns with Type 6 (Commercial Gazettes) for business registrations, company incorporations, and corporate reorganizations.
